declarations.name: goldbach
declarations.exact_statement:
theorem goldbach :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 2 < n → Even n → ∃ p q, Prime p ∧ Prime q ∧ n = p + q

declarations.name: ternaryGoldbach
declarations.exact_statement:
theorem ternaryGoldbach (n : ℕ) (hn : 5 < n) (hn_odd : Odd n) :
    ∃ p q r, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.Prime r ∧ n = p + q + r

declarations.name: legendre_conjecture
declarations.exact_statement:
theorem legendre_conjecture :
    ∀ n ≥ 1, ∃ p ∈ Set.Ioo (n ^ 2) ((n + 1) ^ 2), Nat.Prime p

declarations.name: bounded_gap_legendre

theorem bounded_gap_legendre
    (H : ∃ c > 0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (n + 1).nth Nat.Prime - n.nth Nat.Prime <
      (n.nth Nat.Prime : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ) - c)) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ p ∈ Set.Ioo (n ^ 2) ((n + 1) ^ 2), Nat.Prime p
